blocks.html: In solidarity with the global movement, Earth Hour, Robinsons Malls shall be switching off its lights and start to #Connec2Earth on March 30, at 8:30 PM. Various Robinsons Malls will be celebrating this meaningful event by engaging its patrons in its various Earth Hour activities and parties.

Check out the pre-event affairs and other Earth Hour festivities by following Robinsons Malls at Facebook, Instagram and Twitter. Make sure to include the following participating Robinsons Malls in your list: Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas, Forum Robinsons, Robinsons Galleria-Ortigas, Robinsons Place General Trias, Robinsons Place Ilocos, Robinsons Place Imus, Robinsons Place Las Piñas, Robinsons Place Lipa, Robinsons Magnolia, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons Novaliches, Robinsons Place Naga, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Santiago, Robinsons Starmills, Robinsons Tagaytay, and Robinsons Place Tuguegarao.
